g.text: Market sizing: TAM, SAM, SOM (Pune e-scooters)
TAM: everyone who could ever use it
SAM: reachable with product, price, channels
30% can charge at home and afford it
SOM: share to win in 3 to 5 years
SAM: 45,000 scooters, about Rs 540 crore. SOM: 4,500, about Rs 54 crore
cross-check top-down: does Pune land in the same range?
